planning_notes: Circuit preserves wiring: rgb1 COM->GND.1 and R/G/B->D2/D3/D4; rgb2 COM->GND.1 and R/G/B->D5/D6/D7; bargraph1 C1..C8->GND.1 and A1..A8->D8/D9/D10/D11/D12/D13/D44/D45 in that segment order.
Initialization: all LEDs start off after reset/power-on; bar graph segments start off and rgb color channels start false (OFF).

Bar graph sequencing (A1..A8 with 2s per segment, then repeat) and RGB color mapping for A1-A4 (rgb1=red, rgb2=blue) vs A5-A8 (rgb1=green, rgb2=yellow) are handled in the SysML model (no serial or additional electrical ports required).
Control period selected as 10 ms; the 2-second hold and segment transitions will use elapsed_ms in the model (timing/business logic not placed in these electrical port requests).

configuration_resolution.original_requirement:
Target board is Arduino Mega 2560 as specified in the supplied circuit; use this board when the prose says UNO.


**Task**:
You are tasked with programming an Arduino (uno) to control an LED bar graph (bargraph1) and two RGB LEDs (rgb1, rgb2). The bar graph will display a sequential pattern, while the RGB LEDs will change colors based on the active segment of the bar graph.

**Detail Rules**:
1. **Initialization**: All components start in an off state when powered on or reset.
2. **Bar Graph Sequence**:
   - The bar graph (bargraph1) lights up LEDs sequentially from A1 to A8, one at a time.
   - Each LED remains lit for **2 seconds** before moving to the next.
   - After reaching A8, the sequence restarts from A1.
3. **RGB LED Behavior**:
   - When LEDs A1-A4 are lit, rgb1 must display **red** and rgb2 must display **blue**.
   - When LEDs A5-A8 are lit, rgb1 must display **green** and rgb2 must display **yellow** (red + green).
